faq.book.q: How do I book a bay?
faq.book.a: Pick a lot on Home, choose your vehicle type, tap a green bay, enter the plate, and set the time. Reserve, then pay to get the gate ticket.
faq.pay.a: At checkout choose UPI, card, or cash at the gate. A successful payment opens your QR pass. If a charge fails the bay stays held briefly — retry or cancel from My bookings.
faq.qr.q: The QR will not scan at the gate
faq.qr.a: Raise screen brightness and hold the code toward the operator. You can also show the PKN-… ticket code for them to type. Re-open the pass from My bookings if the page closed.
faq.cancel.q: How do I cancel a booking?
faq.cancel.a: Open My bookings and tap × on a pending or confirmed booking. After check-in it cannot be cancelled in the app — speak to the lot operator or call care.
faq.valet-d.a: When the operator has valet on, you can add it yourself on any car or EV bay. Leave the box unchecked to park yourself. Trucks cannot use valet. The fee is charged once per booking.
faq.plate.a: Cancel before payment and book again with the correct number. After payment, call care with your ticket code and the right plate.
faq.lost.a: Tell the gate your plate and booking time. You can also call 1800 202 7275. For an emergency at the lot, dial 112.
faq.scan.q: How do I run the gate scanner?
faq.scan.a: Open Operations. Scan the QR with the camera or type the PKN code. First scan checks in, second scan checks out. The bay grid updates live.
faq.layout.q: How do I set EV / car / truck bays?
faq.layout.a: In Operations, set lane counts and paint bays on the grid. Changes show on the driver map immediately.
faq.valet-o.q: How do I change valet pricing?
faq.valet-o.a: Turn valet on in Operations, set the one-time fee, and save. Drivers cannot request valet while it is off.
faq.gate-issue.q: A driver's QR will not scan
faq.gate-issue.a: Type the code by hand. Pending means payment is incomplete. A completed visit will check out on the second scan. If it looks wrong, send the ticket code to care.
faq.occ.q: What does the occupancy chart show?
faq.occ.a: A next-24-hour forecast so you can plan busy slots. It is a prediction, not a guarantee.
